verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh has configurable screening configurations, risk-score equations and agentic workflows, so versioning and rollback of automations is a fair axis. However, the pack never documents version history, change review, or rollback for those configurations. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit: API endpoint versioning concerns the API contract, case audit trails track case decisions, and the ability to create multiple configurations is not version control.
